text: Tenneco was taken private in November 2022 by funds managed by Apollo affiliates in an all-cash deal worth roughly USD 7.1bn including debt, and is no longer exchange-listed. Apollo Global Management itself is NYSE-listed with no state stake. The Cadillac F1 partnership is therefore private-equity money, with a debt-loading and cost-cutting risk profile typical of a buyout.
